caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly narrowed neck and a flat base. The jar is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, suggesting a ceramic or earthenware material, and has two small, ear-shaped handles on opposite sides near the top. On the front surface of the jar, there is a simple, freehand blue design that appears to be stylized floral or leaf motifs. The opening of the jar is round and the rim is slightly thickened. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the jar and emphasizing the object as the central focus of the composition.
title: Pickle Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
